module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Top-level synchronous integration wrapper that instantiates the real firmware MMIO block, streaming transport/packet decoder, and safety conditioning block, while directly driving all top-level outputs with RTL sources.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Use the CSR/MMIO block to own configuration and telemetry readback, the transport block to decode bounded command packets and manage external model request/response handshakes, and the safety FSM to decide whether sanitized actuator validity may be asserted. Top-level outputs are wired from real child outputs; no output is left undriven or tied only to a child input.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Keep only the child-module state required by each block. The top itself holds no bulk storage and no hidden software-visible state beyond structural wiring.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Forward actuator_cmd_valid/data and fault_irq from the safety FSM, expose CSR response signals from the MMIO block, expose streaming status from the transport block, and expose model transport request/response direction exactly as specified. On invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions, validity is deasserted rather than replaced.
ownership_notes: Owns only top-level integration and signal fanout.
Does not redefine packet format, register map, or safety policy.
Must not rename ports, modules, or filenames.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_csr_mmio
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Small synchronous register block with explicit address decode for every software-visible register in the contract.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Decode CSR read/write transactions, update writable control fields, and return readable status/telemetry fields through csr_ready/csr_rdata/csr_rvalid. Provide explicit configuration outputs for timeout, clamp bounds, mode enable, slew enable, slew limit, and fault acknowledge.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Store only compact control/status registers and read-response state. No inaccessible internal state is described as software-visible. Freshness reference sequence and epoch are small register-visible values, not bulk history.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive the configuration fields into the safety FSM and present readable STATUS/TELEMETRY data to firmware. Register readback reflects the current decoded register value or status snapshot.
ownership_notes: Owns the real firmware-visible MMIO interface.
Must implement all declared registers in DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.register_contract through RTL decode.
Command data may be observed only for diagnostics; it does not replace the streaming path.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_transport
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Bounded streaming packet decode/format block with ready/valid handshakes and no bulk buffering.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Capture cmd_in_data only when the command handshake is accepted, decode packet fields into semantic outputs, and compute packet validity, malformed, stale, and freshness-related indicators using sequence/epoch/age metadata plus the freshness references from CSR/MMIO. Implement external model transport with request valid/data as outputs, request ready as input, response valid/data as inputs, and response ready as output.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Retain only the minimal state needed for packet decode, handshake alignment, freshness observation, and compact status packet generation. No FIFO arrays or large flip-flop payload storage are used.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive cmd_in_ready, model_request_valid/data, model_response_ready, decoded packet fields, and status_out_valid/data from real RTL logic. Status packet contents are compact and derived from current decode/status state only.
ownership_notes: Owns the command stream ingress/egress protocol and external model transport directionality.
Owns packet-level validity and freshness flags passed to the safety FSM.
Does not infer tensors, geometry arrays, flow fields, or surrogate-model artifacts.

module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_safety_fsm
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Simple synchronous safety controller with inhibit/active behavior, not an elaborate FSM beyond what is implied by validation and timeout gating.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Accept decoded packet semantics only when valid, fresh, and permitted by configuration; otherwise deassert actuator_cmd_valid and latch sticky fault/status for software handling. Apply clamping against programmable min/max bounds and optionally apply simple slew-rate limiting only to otherwise-valid commands.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Maintain only compact mode/inhibit state, last accepted sequence, sticky fault bit, and small counters or flags needed for timeout and freshness enforcement. No substitute command state is created.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive sanitized actuator_cmd_data only when actuator_cmd_valid is asserted. On invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions, validity is inhibited and the fault remains latched for firmware handling.
ownership_notes: Owns actuator gating, clamp/slew conditioning, and sticky fault reporting.
No fallback command, fallback register, fallback controller, substitute command, or fallback-on-reset behavior is permitted.
Current mode and acceptance/rejection code are reported to firmware through the MMIO block.

fsm_intent.description: The transport block is primarily a bounded packet decode/handshake block; it may use simple handshake sequencing and decode control, but no complex FSM is implied beyond protocol idle/accept behavior.

A minimal safety state machine is implied to distinguish active versus inhibit behavior and to latch fault conditions. The simplest implementation is an active/inhibit controller with sticky fault retention and timeout observation.

internal_storage: freshness observation counters or small tracking state
optional small counter(s) for timeout/freshness tracking

sequencing_notes: All state updates are synchronous to clk and use rst_n as the active-low synchronous reset.
CSR/MMIO writes update control registers on accepted transactions; reads return the current register value or a status snapshot.
cmd_in_valid/cmd_in_ready governs packet capture in the transport block; decoded semantic fields are then consumed by the safety FSM in the same synchronous design domain.
The external model transport obeys the mandated direction contract: request valid/data are outputs, request ready is input, response valid/data are inputs, response ready is output.
When a packet is invalid, stale, timed out, malformed, or the design is faulted/in reset, actuator_cmd_valid is deasserted rather than replaced by any substitute value.
timing_notes: Single 50 MHz synchronous clock domain only.
No top-level bus wider than 128 bits is introduced.
The design is intended to meet simple FPGA timing with compact control registers and short decode/control paths.
Any explicit history/FIFO need would be mapped through a technology-neutral memory wrapper suitable for FPGA block RAM; no bulk payload is flattened into flip-flops.
Top-level outputs must always have real RTL drivers.
consistency_notes: No hierarchy, ports, or filenames may differ from digital_spec_json.
